fields.Name: T125 - AI Analytics Model Performance Leaderboard Controls
fields.Description: Model Performance is the only analytics section that surfaces a per-section SortBy + Vendor filter on the shared chrome (CurrentSortBy/CurrentVendor threaded into app-analytics-model-performance) - a distinct per-section control set.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the AI application using the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search box), open the Analytics section, and select the 'Model Performance' section from the left rail. This section's toolbar exposes its own controls: a 'Sort By' selector (By Cost / By Latency / By Usage) and a 'Vendor' filter. Change the Sort By value and/or pick a Vendor. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment - wait, don't navigate away. Success is that the Model Performance section renders with its Sort By and Vendor controls and changing them updates the leaderboard ordering/contents, or a valid empty state appears.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Model Performance section renders with section-specific Sort By and Vendor controls in its toolbar
Changing Sort By and/or Vendor updates the leaderboard contents/order (or shows a valid empty state)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
